text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened when I went to watch a race. 
It seemed Kitasan Black was running in it 
as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Have you happened to see 
Kita-chan anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She hasn't arrived at the racetrack yet... 
The staff are looking for her too, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't have agreed to meet at the 
racetrack... If something happened to her 
on her way here...!
choice_data_list: I'll go search outside for her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm coming too!
choice_data_list: Don't you have a race to run?

You have your race to think about, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Gh, you're right... I understand...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having Satono Diamond stay behind, I set 
out to look for Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Don't give up! Let's try one 
more time! Heave... ho!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I found Kitasan Black on the riverbank. In 
her hands was a rope connected to a truck 
partially submerged in the river.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Just a little more and we can 
pull it out!
choice_data_list: It's almost time for your race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Already...?!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
You're running in a race?! Then you need 
to get going right away!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we'll figure something out on our 
own! Please, go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No! The cargo in this truck has to be 
delivered within the hour, doesn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please let me help until the very last 
second! I'll make sure to get back in time 
for the race!!
choice_data_list: Understood. I'll call it when time's up.

All right. I'll let you know when it's 
time.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay! Hrgh! Let's try again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter how hard they 
persisted, the truck remained stuck fast 
in the river mud...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: We're so... close...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No way, after getting this far...!
Please let me help too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan?! Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We can talk about that later! We just need 
to pull this out, right?

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Another horse girl...! With two of them, 
this just might work!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We can definitely pull it out this 
time...! Everyone, let's gooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heave... hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Heave... hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The combined strength of two horse girls 
was immense— The tires trapped in the mud 
finally rolled, and they managed to haul 
the truck out!

text_block_list.name: Truck Driver
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa! I'll make the delivery time now! 
Thank you! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! When someone's in 
trouble, we help each other out! At least, 
that's what my dad always says!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Rescue mission successful, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Dia-chan, I'm sorry. For making you 
worry right before our race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That goes both ways, doesn't it? I made 
you worry when I felt unwell before, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides, a race without you would be 
terribly lonely. I want to run together 
with you too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You weren't the only one looking forward 
to today, you know?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad! Let's give it everything 
we've got! I want to compete for first 
place with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pinky promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the blue sky, the two of them dashed 
off. Having overcome the crisis, they 
reached their grand stage. Heading 
straight for the track where they swore to 
give their all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. You really saved me by 
coming out, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, honestly Kita-chan, you're always so 
reckless~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you can't really talk either, 
Dia-chan! Running all the way out here 
dressed like that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The moment I thought you might be in 
trouble, I just couldn't sit still!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I suppose we really are two peas 
in a pod, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Whenever you're in a pinch, 
Dia-chan, I'll definitely come running to 
help!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pledging their firm friendship, the two 
ran on. What kind of race would they show 
us? My heart raced with eager 
anticipation.
